request.subject: EFFECT:BOO

layers.text: Change only the colour of the round dome above the mouth: the yellow-brown cap becomes dark teal #1f8f95 with shade #145f6b, the same colour as the lips, so it reads as the top of a round teal head. Do not redraw anything else: keep the wide mouth with its cream teeth, the dark lips and the ring of cream startle lines, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
